result.summary: Found several layout and content clipping issues: restaurant names truncated in the horizontal carousel, category chips cut off on the right, and a heart icon overlapping food imagery.

issues.description: The third restaurant card title 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated mid-word and the delivery fee line may also be incomplete, making the restaurant name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card titles wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or give cards enough width so full names display; avoid mid-word clipping.

issues.description: The category filter row is cut off on the right with only a sliver of the next chip visible, and no clear affordance that more categories exist beyond 'Healthy'.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient edge or ensure partial chips still show enough label text; keep horizontal scroll but improve the peek of the next item.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card sits over the food image with low contrast and no strong circular background, making it harder to see and tap.
issues.suggestion: Place the heart on a solid or semi-opaque circular badge (as on the pizza card below) so it remains visible against busy imagery.

issues.description: Search field placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, grocery' — 'Restarants' appears misspelled (should be 'Restaurants').
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder spelling to 'Restaurants, dishes, grocery'.
